metric_model: CHAOSS AI Alignment - Community Governed Use

scope.note: Scoring confined to the files named on the command line; 'no' means not addressed in those files.

domains.suggested_improvement: no supervision level; no accountability holder named
domains.reasoning: The file only points contributors to an external link for contribution guidelines and contains no mention of AI at all.

domains.suggested_improvement: no mention of meeting/notetaker bots at all
domains.reasoning: No content in this file relates to meetings, recordings, or notetaker bots.

domains.suggested_improvement: no supervision level or accountability holder for content/docs
domains.reasoning: The file does not discuss documentation, blogs, or design asset creation with AI.

domains.suggested_improvement: no supervision level or accountability holder for moderation
domains.reasoning: No moderation-related content is present in this file.

domains.suggested_improvement: no rule on AI use in review; no accountability holder
domains.reasoning: The file makes no statement about who or what may review contributions, nor any mention of AI-assisted review.

domains.suggested_improvement: no supervision level or accountability holder for agentic use
domains.reasoning: No mention of autonomous or agentic AI activity in this file.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on environmental impact of AI use
domains.reasoning: The file contains no discussion of energy, water, or carbon footprint concerns.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on infrastructure strain from AI use
domains.reasoning: The file contains no discussion of server load or hardware cost concerns related to AI.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on training data use or platform user data
domains.reasoning: The file contains no discussion of data use for AI training.

consent_policy_specificity.overall_posture: The reviewed file (docs/en/docs/contributing.md) is a brief pointer to an external contribution guide and contains no mention of AI at all, so none of the nine domains are addressed within it.

awaiting_implementation.specific_tools_in_use: Awaiting implementation: named-product detection beyond known file signatures
awaiting_implementation.ai_tool_owner: Awaiting implementation: ownership and data control
awaiting_implementation.environmental_footprint: Awaiting implementation: model/system card and ESG disclosure
awaiting_implementation.proportionality: Awaiting implementation: resource use relative to contributor count (needs platform usage data)

use_composition_partial.note: Detection only. Absence of signal is not absence of use.

policy_change.blocker: Draft classifier not wired in or validated against hand-graded history. Repo.history() and Repo.commit_patch() supply the diffs.

use_compliance.blocker: Derived metric. Requires disclosed-use data (Use Composition) checked against the specificity grid. Composition is only partially detectable, so the comparison is not yet sound.

misuse.blocker: Not automatable. CHAOSS marks the core signals unknown: text-based AI detectors are unreliable, and license-laundering and wrongful-accusation incidents need maintainer self-report.
